gloss_en: the temporal-and-spatial ordering of seeds (seder ha-zera'im) — the divinely arranged conditions of when and where herbs grow and are harvested, effected through faith, which gives medicinal herbs their power to heal (Likutey Moharan II:5, citing 'emunah — this is Seder Zera'im', Shabbat 31)
canonical_he: הסדר של הזרעים לפי הזמן והמקום
